title: This routine US Navy training mission near California turned into one of the most discussed UFO cases in recent history
description: A 2004 US Navy training mission encountered an unexplained aerial object. Pilots and radar operators observed a peculiar "Tic Tac" shaped craft. Infrared video footage later surfaced, adding to the mystery. This incident gained widespread attention after a 2017 New York Times report. The Pentagon has not provided a definitive explanation for the sighting.

title: Nuclear Lockdown: Massive 2-Tier UFO Spotted Over Texas Weapons Base in New Pentagon Files
description: New Pentagon files reveal a massive two-tiered UFO seen near a Texas nuclear weapons facility, described by a veteran aviator as 'unlike anything' in his 28‐year career.

title: Trump's Ambitious Energy Bet, UFO Council, and Art in Embassies Program Highlight Key News Topics
description: This news text covers a range of topics, including Trump's energy policy, the role of Robert Davi in politics, the accusation of holding a veterans bill hostage, the appointment of a Harvard astronomer to lead the White House UFO council, and the appointment of Erin Scavino to lead the State Department's Art in Embassies program. title: In Roswell, new UFO docs are a declassified bummer
description: ROSWELL, N.M. — Like so many earthlings, John Darr came to Roswell, New Mexico, N.M., looking for answers.
